definition: What it costs to buy the device that carries AI access in Africa: published average selling prices, entry-level price bands, and the volume and price movements around them. Prices are recorded in the currency and period reported by the source.

type_key.projection: Analyst projection for the current year

observations.note: Continental shipments projected to plunge nearly 25% as component costs push entry-level devices up.
Proposed 25% excise duty, which would land directly on device prices.
Continental market grew 3% in the same quarter as the premium mix shifted up.
Market grew 8% in Q1 2026, but component costs were projected to lift device prices by up to 30%.
Prices in several emerging markets up as much as 40% to 50%, weighing on price-sensitive demand.
58% to 63% quarter on quarter; NAND contract prices up 70% to 75%.
Forecast cut to a 26% decline; market leader Transsion shipments fell 14% and its share slipped below 50%.
Close to 3 million units lost. The segment's share fell from 45% to 30% of African shipments in three quarters.
The first year-on-year decline in three years, driven by rising device prices.

observations.source: NielsenIQ, State of the Retail Nation
observations.note: Unit sales fell 7.9% over the same period: more spent, fewer devices bought.
Revised up from a $550 forecast a quarter earlier, with brands passing increased costs to buyers.
Existing models up about 15% globally, new launches 25% costlier, with the Middle East and Africa at 18%.
What affordable now buys. Analysts expect a further 15% to 30% rise through the rest of 2026, with buyers returning to feature phones.
